author: BerrySmooothie
body:
for the past couple of weeks, avicus has been taking a really long time for me to load. 

I was wondering if anyone agrees with me or if its just only me? 
I would really like to fix it. I glitch whenever I try to move in the lobby and it takes about a minute or two to load up to get actually onto the server. Can someone tell me why?!?!!
